top_signals.title: BOE Hikes Rates, Warns of Rising Inflation
top_signals.summary: The Bank of England raised interest rates by a quarter point to 4%, while warning inflation is on track to hit almost 5% next year and signaling another hike is on the cards. Bloomberg's Caroline Hepker reports. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
